26,208 reviews. 4.6 stars. Vinpearl Safari Phú Quốc earns every single one.

This is not a cage zoo. Animals roam across open savannah zones while you ride through on a safari bus. Rare native Vietnamese species. Exotic wildlife from five continents. Conservation programs running behind the scenes.

Kids lose their minds. Adults do too. Half a day minimum, bring sunscreen.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
